meta.name: refactor-completion
meta.author: ralplan
meta.goal: Complete Clean Architecture migration; root becomes cmd/wuzapi/main.go only.

successCriteria: Root contains only cmd/wuzapi/main.go plus non-code files (Makefile, Dockerfile, docs/, deploy/, static/, go.mod, go.sum, .env.sample, README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, .gitattributes, .dockerignore, .golangci.yml, wuzapi.service).
package main appears exactly once, in cmd/wuzapi.
All existing tests pass (contract, unit, integration).
Docker build succeeds; runtime behavior identical to base commit.
make check passes (build + vet + test + lint).

phases.name: root-to-package-wuzapi
phases.title: Root package main → package wuzapi + cmd/wuzapi/main.go
phases.why: Go forbids importing package main. Unblocks phases 11–14.
steps: Create cmd/wuzapi/main.go with func main(), startHTTPMode, startStdioMode
Rename all root .go files from 'package main' to 'package wuzapi'

Export identifiers used across files: server→Server, clientManager→ClientManager, appCtx→AppCtx, container→Container, userinfocache→UserInfoCache, lastMessageCache→LastMessageCache, globalHTTPClient→GlobalHTTPClient, privateIPBlocks→PrivateIPBlocks
Update Makefile BINARY target to build ./cmd/wuzapi
Update Dockerfile go build path to ./cmd/wuzapi
phases.commitMessage: refactor(pkg): rename root package main → wuzapi, extract cmd/wuzapi/main.go

phases.name: extract-myclient-eventhandler
phases.title: Extract MyClient + myEventHandler → internal/whatsapp/client/
phases.why: wmiau.go is 1,531 LOC; myEventHandler alone is 895 LOC. Biggest single-file complexity in root.
steps: Introduce internal/application/port/ClientLifecycle interface (Start, Connect, Disconnect, RegisterEventHandler)
Create internal/whatsapp/client/eventhandler.go with myEventHandler dispatch (from wmiau.go:636-1531)
Create internal/whatsapp/client/startup.go with connectOnStartup + startClient (from wmiau.go:249, 339)
Wire webhookDispatcher, messageHistoryStore, mediaProcessor into MyClient constructor
verify: manual: docker run + connect one user + send one message + verify webhook fires

phases.name: split-helpers
phases.title: Split helpers.go (1,084 LOC) by concern
phases.why: helpers.go conflates webhook, Open Graph, sticker, HMAC. Each has natural internal home.
steps: Move constants to their respective packages (openGraphFetchTimeout et al.)
phases.commitMessage: refactor(helpers): split helpers.go by concern → messaging/media/auth

phases.name: migrate-remaining-root
phases.title: Move stdio, rabbitmq, db, auth, history_sync, clients, constants, custom_handlers, custom_routes, routes
phases.why: Mechanical moves unblocked by phase 10. Each file has natural internal home.
steps: Execute all moves above, one at a time; commit as single squashed atomic phase
Update cmd/wuzapi/main.go to import wiring package
verify: stdio snapshot: echo request → binary → compare response bytes
phases.commitMessage: refactor(structure): migrate remaining 19 root files → internal/**

phases.name: bootstrap-minimize-docs-finalize
phases.title: Minimize cmd/wuzapi/main.go; refresh docs
phases.why: After phases 10–13, cmd/main.go may still exceed 100 LOC due to flag/env parsing. Extract to internal/app/config.
steps: Move flag definitions + env overrides to internal/app/config.Load() *config.Config
Trim cmd/wuzapi/main.go to ≤ 80 LOC (parse config → wire deps → start server)
Run make check as merge gate
phases.commitMessage: refactor(bootstrap): extract config to internal/app/config; finalize docs

risks.description: Circular imports between renamed root pkg and internal/
risks.mitigation: Introduce adapter interfaces in internal/application/port/ before moving impl
Preserve os.Executable() path resolution in cmd/wuzapi/main.go
Run stdio_test.go before + after each phase; snapshot request/response bytes

risks.description: _test.go file lands in wrong package after move
risks.mitigation: Move tests alongside implementation in same commit

risks.description: alice.Chain middleware wiring breaks after router extraction
risks.mitigation: Preserve exact order captured in custom_routes.go:24 (securityHeaders after auth+logging)

notes: Do not run all phases in one autopilot session; intermediate states are regression anchors.
Phase 11 (myEventHandler extraction) deserves manual review of adapter interfaces before proceeding.
Phase 11 recommended solo via /executor with subsequent /verifier pass.
